meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, DBIE, via the Reserve Bank Innovation Hub's data service
meta.revisionPolicy: Bank-wise figures are the banks' own returns as the RBI publishes them and are not revised once printed; the Outlook's latest March is provisional and is replaced by the next edition's figure. Mergers are disclosed on the acquirer, never joined.
meta.coverage: Each scheduled urban co-operative bank's balance sheet: capital, reserves, deposits, borrowings, investments, loans and advances, every March
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 798, the Primary (Urban) Co-operative Banks' Outlook, via the Reserve Bank Innovation Hub's data service (one grid per edition, as on 31 March; a March printed by two editions takes the later edition's figure). Table 11. ₹ crore.
